gaps.summary: Docling/PyMuPDF layout behavior and table structure can still decide whether the LLM sees the correct table and row ordering.
gaps.risk: Broad scorecards can be inflated or unstable if layout fallback behavior changes without a fixed input tuple.
gaps.safe_next_step: Keep Docling configuration fixed and score profile-specific artifacts only.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not replace Docling or alter parser routing under this controller.

gaps.summary: No deterministic Appendix 4C parser/gate module was found; current support is classifier/comparator-schema level only.
gaps.risk: Appendix 4C extraction could be overclaimed if metadata classification is mistaken for metric extraction support.
gaps.safe_next_step: Create a child Appendix 4C readiness audit with cash-flow-only fixture and gate requirements.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not add 4C parser routing or canonical writes without a separate approved task.

gaps.summary: Current multipass table selection relies on deterministic slot selection before LLM extraction and has separate Appendix 5B handling.
gaps.risk: Summary tables, comparative columns, or cash-flow appendix forms can be selected incorrectly unless gates prove table/row binding.
gaps.safe_next_step: Require row/table/page evidence in scored artifacts and keep cash-flow forms out of income-statement metric inference.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not relax table-source requirements to increase apparent coverage.

gaps.summary: The evaluator quarantines all metrics on context period mismatch; period selection is a profile-level gate, not a per-metric nicety.
gaps.risk: A wrong period can make every metric source-backed but financially wrong.
gaps.safe_next_step: Keep period checks as hard gates for canonical_core and expanded_required runs.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not score metrics from a payload with period mismatch.

gaps.summary: Current extraction preserves native non-AUD currency rather than applying FX conversion; unit/scale is inferred from table and context.
gaps.risk: Unit or currency drift can create plausible but wrong magnitude values.
gaps.safe_next_step: Require currency and scale match in all scored runs; label non-AUD native handling explicitly.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not add FX conversion or canonical normalization under this controller.

gaps.summary: Cash-flow and capex rows are vulnerable to parenthesis/sign convention ambiguity, especially in Appendix 5B and current-quarter fields.
gaps.risk: A sign flip can pass surface-level source binding while reversing financial meaning.
gaps.safe_next_step: Appendix 5B and future 4C gates should retain exact signed-value checks.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not convert signs for display without preserving scored raw values.

gaps.summary: Confirmed metric coverage currently has source page/row/table metadata but no local source PDFs resolved in the active data root.
gaps.risk: Cockpit source-page verification cannot prove local PDF-backed accuracy until PDFs resolve or rows are marked DATA_MISSING.
gaps.safe_next_step: Run a child audit to resolve or explicitly classify missing source PDFs without copying production data.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not call rows source-backed/open-verified when the PDF route cannot serve the source.

gaps.summary: Provenance uses structured strings such as source page/detail, derived, prose note, partial, synthetic, or missing.
gaps.risk: Page-only or prose-only evidence is weaker than table/row binding and must not be labeled equivalent to precise evidence.
gaps.safe_next_step: Separate precise, derived, low-traceability, and missing provenance in all reports.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not silently upgrade broad or prose evidence to precise evidence.

gaps.summary: An offline normalizer/reporting spine exists, but it preserves missing-current-accuracy as DATA_MISSING rather than generating accuracy.
gaps.risk: Operators may mistake normalized inventories for accuracy results unless profile labels remain explicit.
gaps.safe_next_step: Keep normalizer output labels profile-specific and include missing-current-accuracy fields.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not collapse canonical_core, expanded_required, and confirmed_metric_coverage into one score.

gaps.summary: Confirmed metric coverage can inventory scored-ready rows, but no current extracted-payload accuracy artifact was found.
gaps.risk: Broad metric accuracy can be claimed without a scorecard if readiness counts are misread as correctness counts.
gaps.safe_next_step: Feed extracted payloads into the scorer only under a child task with source binding and profile labels.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not publish broad accuracy from inventory-only artifacts.

gaps.summary: The confirmed metric coverage tab is review-only and drafts decisions locally; the gold eval tab runs real extraction eval but must keep profile/dataset labels visible.
gaps.risk: Operator UI can unintentionally imply broader trust than the scorecard proves.
gaps.safe_next_step: Keep UI wording profile-specific and continue showing candidate/ambiguous/source-missing states.
gaps.hard_stop: Do not wire draft manual review decisions into canonical labels under this controller.
